assumptions_warnings: LVEF not provided – NICE NG106 first‑line drugs are for HFrEF (LVEF ≤40%). Assume HFrEF based on differential; confirm with echocardiogram.
Blood pressure and heart rate not recorded – start ACE‑I and beta‑blocker at low doses and monitor BP/HR before each titration.
Serum potassium not available – obtain baseline K+ before starting MRA and ACE‑I.
Exact indication for warfarin unknown – verify INR target range and indication (AF vs mechanical valve).
Potential allergy to ACE‑I or SGLT2‑i not documented – ask patient about prior cough, angio‑edema, or genital infections.
Fluid status not documented – assess for edema or dyspnoea before initiating loop diuretic; use furosemide only if congestion present.
treatment_summary: Initiate guideline‑directed heart‑failure therapy with low‑dose ramipril, bisoprolol, spironolactone and dapagliflozin, titrating cautiously given eGFR ~25 mL/min/1.73 m² and advanced age. Add furosemide if clinical congestion is present and consider stopping hydrochlorothiazide as it is ineffective in CKD stage 4. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, INR, blood pressure, heart rate and glucose closely, and obtain missing investigations (LVEF, K+, BP, HR) to guide safe up‑titration.
